purpose: The building module dimensions and the untagged height default are currently grade D or a grade-C candidate derived from OSM's own statistics. The official building register publishes both height and above-ground floor count, which is the only route to grade A. This records the route as verified, not as assumed.

terms.note: Auto-approval and an unrestricted use scope mean this needs no provider correspondence, unlike the NGII DEM request in V1-11 or the S-Map enquiry in V2-2f. The only gate is issuing a service key, which requires the project owner's portal account.

request_parameters.significance_of_optional_lot_number: bun and ji are optional, so a query keyed on the district and legal-dong codes alone returns every 표제부 record in that dong. That is what makes a population statistic possible without solving the per-building join.

code_basis.name: 서울특별시 영등포구 여의도동
code_basis.split_rule: The 10-digit legal-dong code splits into a 5-digit 시군구코드 and a 5-digit 법정동코드. The split is applied here and must be confirmed against the first non-empty response rather than trusted.

fields_that_unlock_the_gates.heit: building height in metres, official record
fields_that_unlock_the_gates.derivation: heit / grndFlrCnt gives a floor-to-floor height from two grade-A inputs. That is the measurement the nine facade families currently assume, and the quantity the 12.0 m untagged default is a stand-in for.
fields_that_unlock_the_gates.verified_from: the response model published on the portal's own API page

join_assessment.question: can register records be matched to individual OSM building ways?
join_assessment.obstacle: The register is keyed by 지번 (bun/ji). OSM here carries 도로명 style addr:street and addr:housenumber for 5.9% and 5.3% of ways respectively, which is a different addressing system, and only 17 of the 456 buildings that actually need a height have a house number at all.
join_assessment.consequence: Per-building attribution is not the realistic first use. The population statistics are: the register gives the true height and floor-count distribution for 여의도동, which is exactly the kind of quantity the 12.0 m default and the nine assumed floor heights are standing in for.

stronger_join_candidate.why: It publishes building footprints already joined to 세움터 register attributes, which would allow a spatial match to OSM footprints instead of an address match. Not assessed in detail yet.

credential_handling.note: The key is a credential. It must not be committed, and the audit fails if one appears in this package.

blocking_reasons: no service key has been issued, so no register record has been retrieved
the sigunguCd and bjdongCd split is derived from the verified 10-digit code and is unconfirmed against a live response
